title: Expressing Continuous Action
subject: English Language
objectives: Describe actions happening right now using -ing verbs

blocks.alt: A teacher writing on the board
blocks.caption: What is the teacher doing?

blocks.md: We use **'is'** or **'are'** + verb + **'ing'** to show an action happening right now.

lines.speaker: Pupil
lines.text: The teacher is writing on the board.

lines.speaker: Pupil
lines.text: The girl is reading a book.

blocks.md: **Rule:** For one person, use **'is'** + verb-ing. For more than one, use **'are'** + verb-ing.

quiz.explain: The teacher is writing on the board.
The girl is reading a book.
